title: Corporate Points Rates on Bag Weight and Size Charges
content:
**Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — baggage terms on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The weight-or-size list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **points rate**, which follows the agreement the ticket names and the points balance it holds. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Agreement named on the ticket | Points balance held | Points rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 15000 or more (high points balance) | 0.8 |
| Active | 5000 or more (middle points balance) and less than 15000 | 0.9 |
| Any other ticket | — | 1 |

The status and the company points balance are read from the agreement's record in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Status | Points balance | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 15,000 | 0.8 |
| Active | 14,999 | 0.9 |
| Active | 5,000 | 0.9 |
| Active | 4,999 | 1 |
| Not active | 40,000 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A list charge of 110 dollars at a points rate of 0.9 becomes 99.00 dollars.
